summary: Iteration 49 — Vametra AI rebrand + reviewer console + camera capture + wait-quiz + auto-heal test. Backend admin endpoints (queue + decide 404 + auth guards) all pass. Frontend: admin-login (email AND ID 00001) succeed → /admin-cms; Google button correctly removed; Verifications tab opens Reviewer Console with 3 status tabs and counts. Verify wizard on desktop: Selfie step exposes BOTH upload label and camera button, camera modal opens/closes correctly; uploading one selfie renders the 'Please stay tuned' wait panel with trivia (quiz-option-0 clickable → quiz-next appears) and a single AI analyze-selfie call completes. Document step on 1280x820: upload label present, camera button absent, phone tip present. CRITICAL: Customer-ID auto-heal is BROKEN for brand-new signups because the shared DO backend POST /api/onboarding/register returns HTTP 500 — the account page stays on 'Activating…' indefinitely (30s+). No frontend/website-backend code bug; this is a DO identity-backend bug that must be fixed on that service.

critical.issue: Returns HTTP 500 when a freshly-signed-up user (Bearer token present) calls /onboarding/register — Customer ID never allocated, /account shows 'Activating…' forever. Reproduced by signing up test_id_hpvwgus8@vametra-test.com and observing REQ→RESP [500] on that endpoint. This is on the shared DO identity backend, not the website backend.

ui_bugs.issue: Because DO /onboarding/register returns 500, the 'ID: Activating…' string never resolves. Frontend has no retry/backoff/toast — user sees the stale placeholder indefinitely with no error hint. Consider surfacing an error state + a manual retry button.

integration_issues.issue: AuthContext calls DO /onboarding/register once; on 500 it does not retry or notify user, so a brand-new account is permanently stuck without a Customer ID.

action_items: Escalate DO backend /api/onboarding/register 500 to the DO identity-backend team — it fires for every brand-new signup, blocking Customer-ID allocation. Include a captured UID (e.g. uoIwG4QIwfYOp1JzbNUcimBvxDN2) so they can inspect logs.
In AuthContext, add a short bounded retry (3× with backoff) + surface an error state and a manual 'Retry activation' affordance so users are not stuck on 'Activating…' forever when DO 500s.
Everything else in this iteration verified GREEN — no code fix needed for admin login, reviewer console, camera capture UI, VerifyWait panel, or document-step desktop gating.
critical_code_review_comments: verify.py admin endpoints require_admin fallback via X-Admin-Token works and returns clean shape {items, counts} — good.
VerifyBuyer.jsx correctly gates document-camera button behind IS_MOBILE and shows verify-doc-camera-note for desktops.
AuthContext auto-heal has no retry/backoff on DO 500; add exponential retry + visible error UI (see action_items).
AccountPage.jsx custId fallback text 'Activating…' has no timeout — should switch to error state after N failures.
